newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Zhuzhou Jan-Apr zinc production up 185 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Zhuzhou Jan-Apr zinc production up 185 pct.

text.p: China's Zhuzhou Smelter produced 93,821 tonnes of zinc and alloys in the first four months of 1997, up 185 percent from the same period in 1996, while exports jumped 245 percent, the smelter announced on Friday.
Zinc production in April this year reached 28,272 tonnes, the smelter said in a faxed statement.

"The production increase is mainly due to (a) 100,000 tonne production line that came onstream last year and now the new production line has (reached) full capacity and is also processing national zinc stocks," the statement said.
Zhuzhou exported 56,597 tonnes of zinc and alloys in the first four months of 1997, a 245 percent increase compared to the same period in 1996, it said.
"Currently Zhuzhou Smelter holds 70,000 tonnes of zinc concentrate stocks which is two times higher than the normal stock level," the statement said.
From January to March, Zhuzhou Smelter produced 65,549 tonnes of zinc and zinc alloys, the smelter said, clarifying a previous statement.
In a statement issued earlier this month, Zhuzhou said it had produced about 59,078 tonnes of zinc and zinc alloy, a 30 percent increase over the same period last year.
Zhuzhou Smelter also said earlier this month it had decided to increase its annual zinc output to 260,000 tonnes per year in 1997, from its previous target of 210,000 tonnes per year.
